ctx.x: And I very consciously knew that Dave was this really popular figure in jazz and I couldn’t compete in that world but I really wanted to have a really really creative rock & roll band. And the first thing we did was the group was called The New Heavenly Blue. We did a record on RCA. And then we did a record on Atlantic. And that evolved into a group called Sky King that we did a record on Columbia. And Madcat, the great harmonica player who I still play with and who played with two generations of Brubeck, he was…

Right. And Jerry Bergonzi and also the background singer coach was this guy named Luther, Luther Vandross. And that record never even came out because the guy that was head of Columbia A&R, Mickey Eichner, was a complete idiot. I hope he hears this someday — oh he’s probably gone. But he was totally threatened to have Bob James on Tappan Zee Records come into the Columbia label fold. So just by bad luck the first project he could kill to show Bob James who had more power, it was our record. So despite it being…
